A spin-out from Umeå University.

Founded by Antón Carcedo and Åke Brännström

Senva grew out of research at Umeå University. We’re supported by the university’s Innovation Office and by Umeå University Holding through its Venture Track programme.

The kit you use at home.

Senva Health is our at-home saliva kit. It arrives in one box, with a tube and a funnel for your sample. Give your sample, close the tube and post it back to the lab.

From one saliva sample to concrete steps.

  1. 1

    Order online

    A saliva kit arrives at your home.

  2. 2

    Take the sample at home

    No needles. It takes about five minutes.

  3. 3

    Analysed in Europe

    A European lab measures the marks on your DNA, and our model interprets them.

  4. 4

    Act, then test again

    Clear next steps on nutrition, movement and sleep. Test again to follow your trend.

What makes Senva Health different.

It runs on our own model of epigenetic ageing, developed at Umeå University.

A result we can explain

Our model reads a small set of marks on your DNA, so we can explain what drives your result, not just give you a number.

No needles, no clinic

Our model is built for saliva from the start, so you can take the test at home in a few minutes.

Your results stay in Europe

Your sample is analysed in a European lab, and your results are kept safe under the EU’s data protection rules (GDPR).

What you get.

A report you can understand, with steps you can act on.

  • Your biological age

    How old your body seems, compared with your age in years.

  • Your pace of ageing

    How fast you are ageing right now.

  • Your next steps

    Clear, practical steps on nutrition, movement and sleep.

  • Your trend

    When you test again, how your results have changed.

Epigenetic, not genetic.

Your genetic code stays the same all your life. Epigenetic marks don’t. They shift with age and with how you sleep, move, eat and handle stress, which is why your result can change when you do.

Marks on your DNA

The best-studied mark is DNA methylation, a small chemical tag on the DNA letter C. Identical twins start out with almost the same pattern, and it drifts apart as they age (Fraga et al., 2005).

Clocks that measure ageing

In 2013, researchers showed that methylation at a set of DNA sites predicts a person’s age, in blood and across most tissues of the body (Horvath, 2013).

Shaped by how you live

Diet, education and body weight are linked to faster or slower epigenetic ageing (Quach et al., 2017).

Senva Health reads a small set of these marks to estimate your biological age.

How epigenetic clocks work

Questions.

What is biological age?

It’s an estimate of how old your body seems, based on markers such as epigenetic marks, compared with your age in years. If it’s lower than your age in years, your body shows fewer signs of ageing than expected. How epigenetic clocks work

What will my report show?

Your biological age, how fast you are ageing, and clear next steps on nutrition, movement and sleep. When you test again, it also shows your trend.

Is Senva Health a medical test?

No. Senva Health is a wellness test that helps you understand how you are ageing and what to work on. It doesn’t diagnose disease. If you have health concerns, talk to your doctor.

Do you read my genes?

No. We don’t look at your genetic variants, and we don’t report on your ancestry or your inherited risk of disease. We measure epigenetic marks: small chemical tags on your DNA that shift with age and with how you live.

Why saliva and not blood?

Saliva is easy to give at home, with no needles, and it carries DNA from your own cells. That’s why we designed Senva Health around it.

How do you know it works?

We’re testing the test before launch, with repeat saliva samples from volunteers. More about this work

Is my data safe?

Yes. Your sample is analysed in a European lab, and your results are kept safe in Europe under the EU’s data protection rules (GDPR). We never sell your data. Sign-ups to our waiting list go through Formspree, a form service in the USA. How we handle your sign-up

Can I delete my data?

Yes. Ask us at any time and we’ll delete it.

How often should I test?

Testing again shows your trend over time. We’ll suggest when to retest when we launch.

When can I order?

We plan to launch in the EU in 2027. Join the waiting list and we’ll tell you first.
